6.desc:
Egg Roll by Agri Kind is a dessert-forward, indica-dominant hybrid (roughly 70% indica) crafted from the celebrated cross of Chemdawg and Biscotti. This boutique strain earns its name from its distinctive, tightly packed buds that resemble savory egg rolls—dense, resinous, and layered with trichomes.

Appearance & Aroma
Agri Kind’s Egg Roll showcases bright emerald-green nugs accented by deep purple leaves and thin, fiery orange pistils, all blanketed in a frosty, shimmering coat of white crystal trichomes. Its aroma is a playful fusion of sweet, fruity plum and savory culinary spice, underscored by notes of black pepper, earthy sage, and a subtle diesel-gas finish.

Flavor & Effects
On the palate, Egg Roll delivers a smooth, dessert-like experience: upfront sweetness of ripe plum and berry gives way to a peppery, herbal exhale with hints of earthy spice and faint citrus. Effects begin with a euphoric, giggly head buzz that melts into deep, full-body relaxation—often culminating in couch-lock and dreamy sedation. Ideal for evening use, it’s favored for stress relief, anxiety management, chronic pain, muscle spasms, and insomnia.

Hippie Crasher, also known as “Hippy Crasher,” is an indica dominant hybrid strain (80% indica/20% sativa) created through crossing the delicious Wedding Cake X Kush Mints strains. If you're looking for a bud that will really take hold and knock out any aches or pains, you've found it with Hippie Crasher. This bud comes on fast and hard, launching your mood to new levels of happiness while dropping your body into a state of pure physical relaxation and ease. You'll feel a euphoric creativity wash over your mental state, activating your mind and leaving you sociable and outgoing. As you carry on conversations with those around you, your body will begin to fall deeper and deeper into a relaxing and sedative state that can have you couch-locked and dozing. With these effects and its high THC level, Hippie Crasher is perfect for treating chronic stress, depression, mood swings, nausea or appetite loss, chronic pain and insomnia. This bud has a sweet and fruity berry cake flavor with a lightly nutty minty cookie exhale. The aroma is of sweet fruity cherries and sharp mint with hints of spicy nuts, too. Hippie Crasher buds have fat dense heart-shaped minty green nugs with orange hairs and a coating of tiny frosty white crystal trichomes.

148.desc:
We are committed to providing our guests with medicinally potent products that harness the remarkable healing potential of cannabis. Rick Simpson Oil (RSO) is a potent, full spectrum extract that may capture a more complete range of the beneficial compounds in cannabis than other forms of extract. Pioneered by Rick Simpson during his battle with basal cell carcinoma, RSO gained acclaim as he attributed his recovery to its use and began sharing his discovery publicly. His work helped propel global awareness and advocacy for the medicinal potential of cannabis.

We begin with the full spectrum extraction of cured premium cannabis material. We fill fine mesh bags with cannabis and load them into our extractor with food-grade ethanol. The ethanol extracts cannabinoids and terpenes in addition to other beneficial botanical compounds to capture the full spectrum profile of the plant. We filter the solution to remove any undesirable biomass or compounds and then remove all of the ethanol using a combination of vacuum and heat to distill the alcohol from the extract.

After the ethanol is completely removed, we decarboxylate the oil. This chemical reaction occurs when we apply heat to the cannabinoid acids in the extract, such as THCA or CBDA, which are the non-psychoactive precursors found in raw cannabis. In doing so, we are converting our precursor cannabinoid acids to psychoactive compounds like delta 9 THC and CBD, respectively. The decarboxylation step is crucial to activate the beneficial effects of the final product for ingestion or topical use. This final processing step produces the dark, highly pure and potent RSO.

Our filtered and decarbed full-spectrum RSO is now ready to be either added into edibles or packaged into dispensers for wide-use applications. 

RSO can be ingested or applied topically. Due to the oil’s high concentration of plant waxes and fats, it should NOT be dabbed, smoked, or vaporized. One of the most popular and effective ways to take RSO is through sublingual administration – placing it under the tongue. The mouth’s mucus membranes allow for rapid absorption of cannabinoids directly into the bloodstream.

Please note that this is a very potent product, and we highly recommend discussing dosage and administration with a budtender if you are new to RSO.

149.desc:
Pie Dough Bx1 x Grape Pie Wedding Crasher

Though pheno-hunting is always something of a lottery, we often seem to hit the jackpot with Crystal Rose Seed Co.’s genetics. Producing winners like Pie Eyed, Wave Runners, and Watermelon Otai, their complex, one-of-a-kind crosses always have us coming back for more, and Grape Crepe is no different.

Prior to the creation of Grape Crepe, Crystal Rose had the opportunity to work with MegaRaw’s brand-building, in-house selected phenotype of Pie Dough, and he crossed it with his own Pie Eyed selection to create Pie Dough Bx1. He then crossed Pie Dough Bx1 with Grape Pie Wedding Crasher, a male known for its abundant resin and grape terps, to create Grape Crepe. Our cultivation team has selected two phenotypes of Grape Crepe: one for flower and the other for solventless extracts, and we have found this cultivar to be a wild improvement on the grape category as a whole.

Opening a jar of our flower phenotype, Grape Crepe #61, launches a purple wave of grape juice and grape candy streaked with a subtle gassy note – an aroma that translates impeccably to flavor with vaporization or combustion. A balanced combination of stress-melting relaxation and uplifting euphoria is consistent with its lineage of Pie Dough, Grape Pie, Wedding Cake, and Purple Punch.

In the case of Ice Cream Bananaz, the mother strain, Ice Cream Nana, was introduced to enhance and amplify the foundation of Strawberry Runtz. 166.desc:
Watermelon Zkittlez x Pie Eyed

Springing from the well that never seems to run dry, Watermelon Otai comes from a breeder that is likely already familiar to Breakwater regulars – “Maine-stay” Crystal Rose Seed Co. Our team’s success with Crystal Rose projects like Pie Eyed and Wave Runners has fueled our anticipation of yet another standout cross from this dynamic duo.

As fruit-dominant flavors seem to multiply exponentially with each passing year, watermelon has proven to be an elusive and coveted flavor that is difficult for breeders to capture. Pursuing this challenging prize, Crystal Rose crossed a Watermelon Zkittlez female with his Pie Eyed male. Growing similarly to its paternal lineage, our pheno displays average height and symmetrical branching. The flowers exhibit the maternal traits of the Zkittlez lineage, but with the added luster of Pie Eyed’s abundant trichome coverage. Resinous buds emit sugary-sweet watermelon and strawberry aromas, akin to a frozen tropical drink. After curing, a creamy undertone emerges to complement the candy-like layers of mellow watermelon and ripe strawberry, giving the strain its unique moniker, Watermelon Otai. (If you’re not familiar with “otai”-style drinks, you’re not alone! This Polynesian drink, originating in Tonga, combines coconut water, coconut milk, and tropical fruits such as mango, pineapple, and, almost always, watermelon). 

In Live Hash Rosin, the creaminess is exchanged for a more gassy profile which merges with those old-fashioned hard candy flavors. Delivering stress-melting effects that parallel Pie Eyed, Watermelon Otai’s tranquil, transporting relief is an on-demand tropical vacation.

The high is balanced and blissful, part head, part body, wrapping you in warmth without slowing you down. Flavor and effects
The defining character is sweet strawberry and berry flavor with a smooth, refreshing finish. Canna Caviar positions it as a botanical-terpene blend: premium distillate flavored with natural botanical terpenes, intended to provide a discreet experience with little or no conventional cannabis aroma.

Expect a light, balanced cerebral lift rather than a heavy, sedating effect. The brand describes its botanical line—including Caviar Sunrise—as uplifting, relaxed, happy, and clear-headed, while a dispensary listing specifically calls Sunrise a strawberry-flavored sativa suited to a bright, energizing mood.

Caviar Sunrise may appeal to someone seeking a flavorful vape for socializing, creative activities, or daytime relaxation without an intensely pungent scent. For example, it could fit a weekend walk, casual gathering, or low-key creative session better than a nighttime, couch-lock-oriented product.

Because its THC level is high, start with a small inhalation and wait before taking more—especially if you have a low tolerance. Effects can vary by individual, dose, and product batch.

Expect a sweet tropical inhale with notes of fresh banana, citrus, lemon candy, and subtle earthiness on the finish. The aroma leans fruity and sour-sweet, with a smooth tropical character that makes every hit flavorful and satisfying.

The experience builds gradually, starting with an uplifting wave of euphoria and happy, giggly energy before settling into a calm, relaxed body feel. Potent, layered, and memorable.

It usually feels balanced and uplifting, a friendly pick for newer consumers who still want real depth and a smooth landing.

577.desc:
Blue Limeade from Garden Greens is a balanced hybrid celebrated for its sweet, juicy fruit character and zesty lime sparkle on the nose and palate. The aroma blends bright lime, ripe berry-blue notes, and a subtle herbal edge, all wrapped in a distinctly “dank” funk that keeps it loud and grown-up rather than candy-soft. On the inhale, expect a burst of citrus-lime and soft sweetness, followed by a slightly earthy, herbal exhale that lingers on the tongue like a terp-heavy limeade.

The high is often described as full-bodied yet balanced: a quick cerebral lift that smooths into an easygoing, relaxed state without immediate couchlock, making it suitable for afternoon or early evening sessions. Altogether, Blue Limeade is a flavor-first hybrid that pairs expressive citrus-funk terps with a rounded, mood-brightening effect profile ideal for everyday connoisseurs.

578.desc: Blue Taffeze is a hybrid known for its dessert-inspired aroma, blending sweet berry candy notes with creamy taffy and subtle hints of citrus and earth. Dense, frosty buds and a rich terpene profile make this cultivar stand out for its smooth, flavorful smoke, offering a balanced experience that showcases its candy-forward character without overpowering complexity.

579.desc: A cruffin is a hybrid of a croissant and a muffin. Our Cruffin is none of that, and it’s also not that Blue Sherbet x Zkittles cross that’s billed as “Blueberry Cruffin” on the interwebs. Ours is a different beast, a cross of Thin Mintz x DJ Short Blueberry. Ours will punch you in the face and steal your keys. Don’t have important things to do when you Cruffin. Don’t try to hold a deep conversation while Cruffining. Forget what you were saying? You’ve been Cruffin’d. It’s so good we printed stickers early. Don’t sleep, fam.

580.desc: Rolled up and ready to smoke, Pre-Rolls are a convenient and effective way to consume cannabis. Pre-Rolls come in many different forms and can be rolled with flower, shake, "b-buds", infused with concentrates, and more.

581.desc: Candy Fumez is playful candy flavor with a little grown-up depth. It is sweet, creamy, and just slightly gassy. Sherbanger × Zkittlez leans bright and fruit-forward, then finishes smooth with a hazy, feel-good buzz. Great for social sessions when you want to float pleasantly without getting knocked out.

582.desc: Garden Greens Chem 51 is an indica-dominant option built for customers who love bold, gassy cannabis with a heavy, satisfying edge. This strain delivers a loud chem-forward aroma packed with fuel, earthy funk, peppery spice, and hints of citrus and cool mint, creating a rich, complex profile from the first grind to the final exhale.

583.desc: Chem 51 #7 is classic gas with a sweet twist, like Chem D cleaned up with a fruit-candy chaser. Chem D × Eye Candy keeps the diesel punch and pungent aroma, but softens the edges with surprising sweetness. Expect a strong, heady ride that is best for experienced users who like their highs loud and cerebral.

584.desc:
Chem 51 from Garden Greens is a potent hybrid with a loud chem-forward profile and a reputation for heavy, relaxing effects. It typically comes across as gas, funk, and sharp sour-menthol notes on the nose, with peppery spice and a cool, minty edge that keep the flavor profile layered rather than one-dimensional.

On the inhale, expect a pungent, diesel-like start that fans of classic Chem strains usually love, followed by a savory, slightly herbal finish. Garden Greens’ listing also highlights limonene and beta-caryophyllene, which points to a mix of bright citrus lift and grounded spice in the background. That combination often gives Chem 51 a brisk first impression before it settles into a deeper body-heavy feel.

In terms of effect, Chem 51 is usually described as strong, sleepy, and anti-inflammatory, making it better suited for winding down than for staying sharply active. Overall, Chem 51 is a bold, old-school-leaning modern hybrid for consumers who want serious gas, high potency, and a calming finish.

The experience leans relaxed, lifted, and versatile, making Chrome Dome a solid choice for laid-back plans, casual hangs, or simply settling into a calm mood without going too heavy. Expect a smooth hybrid session with balanced head and body effects, a flavorful finish, and an easygoing vibe that makes it a dependable everyday pick.

The high is stimulating yet heavy, locking the body while the mind drifts in all directions. It’s so familiar, I can’t really tell if this is yesterday or today. It’s today, right? Whew. Distinctive, flavorful, and full of contrast, Giraffe Puzzy brings a fresh identity to the hybrid lineup.

Jersey Runtz from Garden Greens is a sweet, candy-like hybrid with the kind of bold flavor profile that has made Runtz family strains so popular. It usually brings fruity, tropical notes up front, followed by creamy undertones and a light earthy or gassy finish that adds depth to the experience.

The flower is typically dense, frosty, and visually striking, with bright green buds, purple accents, and vivid orange hairs. That polished look gives it strong bag appeal and makes it feel like a premium craft selection.

In terms of effects, Jersey Runtz is often described as balanced and enjoyable, starting with an upbeat, happy headspace before easing into a calm, relaxed body feel. It can be a good choice for people who want something flavorful and smooth without feeling overly heavy too soon.

Overall, Garden Greens’ Jersey Runtz delivers a well-rounded mix of sweetness, aroma, and relaxation. It’s the kind of strain that appeals to consumers who like dessert-style cannabis with a lively, approachable finish.

Jersey Runtz delivers an upbeat, euphoric lift that eases into relaxed body calm, making it a versatile choice for any time of day.

True to its name, this premium cultivar is celebrated for its decadent, dessert-like terpene profile and its heavy, soothing effects, making it a staple choice for evening unwinding and stress relief. Peanut Butter Cup delivers an authentic, nutty aroma that smells remarkably like a scoop of creamy, rich peanut butter mixed with sweet vanilla and a touch of candy sweetness. Breaking apart the dense, resin-coated nugs releases a sharp undertone of herbal spice and pungent earth. On the exhale, the smoke is thick and smooth, leaving a distinct nutty, sweet, and lightly toasted cookie dough flavor lingering on the palate. This cultivar packs a heavy "couch-lock" potential best saved for nighttime routines, lazy weekends, or a deep movie marathon. It lands with a soft wave of happy, hazy cerebral bliss that immediately shuts down racing thoughts and daytime anxiety. Shortly after, its heavy physical traits roll in, sending a deeply calming warmth across your muscles to melt away physical tension, stress, and chronic aches. It is widely favored as an elite sleep-aid or end-of-day recovery strain.

When smoked, the flavor mirrors the aroma: an initial surge of tart lemon-lime evolves into a smooth, candy-sweet finish, with a subtle hint of minty chill leaving the palate clean and refreshing.

Named for the iconic candy, Red Hotz packs a delicious flavor and happy, bright high that is a great option for a lazy afternoon when you need to get to doing some things on your to-do list. The taste of Red Hotz is just like its namesake treat, with a sweet and sugary berry candy taste accented by zesty, spicy oranges and a hint of fresh red fruits. The aroma is very similar, with a spicy, peppery orange overtone accented by hints of earthiness and a touch of sweet fruity red candies. The Red Hotz high will wash over you quickly, filling your mind with a soaring sense of bright energy. You'll feel utterly euphoric and super creative, ready to get to work on anything artistic at hand. These effects will grow and grow with no ceiling, which can aggravate anxiety at times. In combination with its super high 20-25% average THC level, these effects make Red Hotz a great option for treating experienced patients with a variety of conditions including chronic fatigue, chronic pain, chronic stress or PTSD, nausea and depression or mood swings. This bud has fluffy and oversized, rounded forest green nugs with dark amber undertones, thin dark amber hairs and a frosty coating of tiny, sparkling gold-tinted white crystal trichomes.

Sherbanger is an evenly balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) created through crossing the classic Sherbet X Headbanger strains. 

If you're after a super heavy bud with an insanely delicious flavor, you've found it with this gorgeous gal. Sherbanger brings on hard-hitting effects and a super high potency level with each and every toke, all wrapped up with a mouthwatering flavor. Like its celebrity parents, Sherbanger packs a sweet and sour creamy citrus flavor with hints of spicy herbs and fresh fruity blueberry gelato. The aroma is very similar, with a fruity gelato overtone accented by spicy diesel and a punch of sour citrusy herbs. 

The Sherbanger high will slam into your brain almost as soon as you exhale, launching your mind into a tingly and stimulating state of creativity and happiness. You'll be socially inclined in this state, easily chatting with anyone and everyone around you. A light physical calm accompanies this heady boost, helping you to stretch out and relax without dampening your energy level. With these effects and its high 20-22% average THC level, Sherbanger is often chosen to treat a variety of conditions including mood swings or depression, chronic pain, headaches or migraines and nausea.

Jungle Juice packs a juicy sweet and sour citrus flavor with an aftertaste that is surprisingly just like a banana. The smell is of sweet pine and bananas with an earthy pungent effect that's released as the nugs are burned. Jungle Juice buds have round and super tight dark olive green nugs with dark purple undertones, bright amber hairs, and a coating of light lavender colored crystal trichomes. The Jungle Juice high is both energizing and relaxing in nature, perfect for giving you the energy you need on those days where you just can't get going. The high starts with a creative energetic boost that lifts your spirits and leaves you feeling artistically inspired. You'll be euphoric in this soaring state with no real way of coming down

Permanent Marker’s unique blend of floral, fruity, and diesel notes makes it a singular experience, like the markers we used to sniff as kids.

851.desc: Super Lemon Haze by Grown Rogue bursts with bright citrus flavor, blending zesty lemon and sweet candy notes into a smooth, refreshing smoke. Bold and vibrant from the first inhale, this classic favorite delivers an upbeat, clear-headed experience that keeps the energy high, creativity flowing, and conversations going.

852.desc: A super potent bud with an eye-watering stench, Tear Gas is a great option for any fan of balanced hybrid strains. The aroma of Tear Gas is heavy and potent, with a gassy diesel overtone that intensifies with chemical spiciness the more that you toke. The flavor isn't much lighter, with a dank diesel taste accented by a light touch of woody pine. The Tear Gas high will hit you quickly, filling your mind with a quick-hit of surprisingly bright energy and motivation. You'll feel focused and creative, ready to get social or get working on anything artistic. A heavy physical high comes next, creeping in slowly before fully relaxing you from head to toe and leaving you ready to kick back.

855.desc: G10 from Harvest Moon Farms is a sativa-leaning hybrid flower. Customers describe the experience as uplifted, happy and creative. Enjoy it as a daytime pick for creative projects, a playlist and a sketchbook, a walk or hike outdoors, or catching up with friends. Recent lab results put beta-caryophyllene at the top of its terpene profile, bringing a peppery, warm-spice edge, followed by limonene, with a bright, zesty citrus note, and myrcene, which adds an earthy, ripe-fruit depth. That mix is what you smell when the package opens and what carries through on the inhale and exhale. Beyond THC, testing also shows measurable CBG and CBGA, minor cannabinoids that round out the overall profile. Sativa-leaning strains are generally described as uplifting, upbeat and clear-headed. Customers tend to reach for sativas like this one for daytime plans: getting into a creative project, heading out on a hike, or catching up with friends.

Sicilian Sunset delivers a bold and memorable flavor experience. The inhale is dominated by rich Sunset Sherbet notes, while the exhale finishes with a sweet, candy-like Zkittlez profile that lingers on the palate. This is a cultivar built for true flavor enthusiasts—complex, delicious, and unlike anything else on the shelf.

Don’t let the sweet flavor fool you—Sicilian Sunset brings plenty of power. The effects are pleasantly uplifting and euphoric while still offering a satisfying, stoney body feel. It strikes an ideal balance, providing enough potency to be felt without slowing you down, making it a versatile hybrid suitable for both daytime and evening enjoyment. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or taking in a beautiful sunset, Sicilian Sunset is the perfect companion—especially if that sunset happens to be overlooking the Sicilian coast.

This gummy bar is commonly listed as a 100 mg product and is often associated with sativa-leaning effects, which can make it feel more upbeat and daytime-friendly. As a gummy bar, it also offers practical dosing because it can be split into smaller pieces for controlled use. Overall, it’s a flavorful, solventless edible for people who want tropical fruit taste, reliable dosing, and a fuller hash rosin experience in one convenient format.

926.desc:
Honey Lavender Chamomile Flavor
With THC, CBN, 1:1

HIGHLY is a water-soluble, solventless hash rosin powder — a completely new way to consume cannabis.
We’ve basically found a way to make rosin edible in the cleanest way possible - No smoke. No sugar. No chemicals. No nonsense.
Oh, and did I mention its water soluble?

927.desc:
Blueberry Diesel is a flavorful hybrid that perfectly blends the sweet, berry-rich taste of Blueberry with the potent, fuel-forward punch of Sour Diesel. The result is a well-balanced strain that offers the best of both worlds — uplifting cerebral effects and soothing body relaxation.

Its buds are dense and frosty, showcasing shades of deep green and blue-purple hues, with bright orange pistils. The aroma is a mouthwatering mix of ripe blueberries, sour citrus, and pungent diesel, making it a favorite among flavor connoisseurs.

Blueberry Diesel delivers a clear-headed, euphoric high followed by a gentle, calming body buzz. It’s ideal for daytime or early evening use, helping ease stress, anxiety, and minor aches while keeping you mentally alert and uplifted.

929.desc:
Hypnotik is an incredibly potent hybrid strain known for its euphoric and deeply relaxing effects. This strain is ideal for those seeking an uplifting experience with a powerful sense of calm. A balanced blend of indica and sativa, Hypnotik delivers a smooth, calming high that may start with a burst of creativity and happiness, followed by a deeply soothing body relaxation.

Its sweet and earthy aroma, often tinged with hints of citrus and pine, adds to the overall enjoyable experience. Hypnotik is perfect for unwinding after a long day or as a companion for creative pursuits. Its well-rounded effects make it suitable for both daytime and evening use, though it’s best for users with a moderate tolerance due to its potency. Whether you're looking to melt away stress or spark some inspiration, Hypnotik offers a truly mesmerizing experience.

930.desc:
Elevate your routine without overcommitting. Our premium 3-pack pre-rolls is designed for those who demand top-shelf potency and flavor in a convenient, pocket-sized format. We start with exceptional, single-source flower, ground to perfection. Then, we infuse it with pure cured resin—capturing the deeply complex, authentic terpene profile and robust cannabinoids of perfectly aged cannabis. The result? A slow, even burn with a rich flavor profile and an elevated potency that hits well above its weight class.

Perfect for a solo session, a quick midday reset, or sharing with friends.

931.desc:
Lil buddies morning diesel is a are a sativa-dominant 3-pack (1.05g total) featuring premium whole flower infused with cured resin. This cross of Morning Glory and Chunky Diesel delivers fuel-forward diesel aromas with energizing, clear-headed, and euphoric daytime effects.

Sharp, pungent diesel, crisp pine, zesty citrus pith, and earthy undertones.

933.desc: Purple Starfruit is a calm and functional evening strain, offering versatile full-body relaxation paired with mental ease. The aroma is distinctively rich and layered with fruity candy balanced by earthy mint and subtle gas. This indica stands out for both its soothing potency and undeniable bag appeal.

The aroma is a complex and captivating blend of sweet, tropical fruit, floral notes, and a hint of black pepper. Users report a clear-headed and euphoric high that gently transitions into a soothing body relaxation, making it an ideal choice for unwinding and stress relief.

Its buds are dense and frosty, with light green hues and amber pistils, giving off a sweet, doughy scent layered with subtle fuel notes. This strain is perfect for evening use, offering a calming body high that melts away tension without heavy mental fog.

Ideal for winding down after a long day, Scotch and Soda is favored by users seeking relief from stress, insomnia, and physical discomfort, or simply looking to unplug and indulge in a mellow, flavorful smoke.

The dark green, medium-sized buds are a vibrant and generously coated with orange pistils. Much like a fresh glass of orange juice, Sunny D is a Sativa hybrid that could be perfect for kicking off the day and getting your mind and body energized.

940.desc: The pursuit of the golden hour inspired this uplifting, tropical flavor. Fresh, juicy watermelon and ripe strawberry blend seamlessly with notes of warm coconut. A refreshing twist on a colada (without the pin~a).

941.desc: In the mountains, on the beach, or just in your backyard–any place is a good place to pitch a tent and build a fire. Sweet with a hint of vanilla, Happy Camper is the perfect flavor to roast while mellowing (see what we did there?).

942.desc: Bake some leisure into your self-care routine–you deserve it. Leisure hits first as sweet and tart mango, but finishes with a delicious juicy citrus note reminiscent of yuzu fruit. Nothin’ but hammock vibes.

Expect an alert, upbeat lift that pairs well with morning routines, creative tasks, or staying engaged on the move. This blend is rolled to deliver a smooth, reliable smoke that keeps things light, focused, and ready for whatever’s next. A solid choice when “later” isn’t an option and energy matters.

957.desc:
Banana Pie infused pre-rolls take the rich, nostalgic taste of banana cream pie and elevate it with premium flower. Each pre-roll is infused with our signature Banana Pie terpene oil, blending the tropical sweetness of ripe bananas with waves of warm vanilla custard and a whisper of flaky pastry. As you draw in, notes of candied banana swirl into creamy undertones, instantly transporting you to a sunlit bakery counter.

Beneath that dessert-like flavor, the terpene lineup guides the mood from the first inhale onward. Limonene injects a burst of uplifting energy, while Caryophyllene’s gentle spice adds a cozy warmth. Terpinolene brings a touch of floral clarity, and Myrcene’s earthy musk soothes the senses. Humulene rounds out the profile with subtle herbal depth, smoothing the journey into a clear-headed ease.

As the experience settles, a soft sweetness lingers, leaving you in a contented, buoyant state. Banana Pie pre-rolls shine during leisurely afternoons spent with friends, quiet moments of inspiration, or simply whenever you’re craving a sweet pick-me-up.

The harmonious fusion of Chem Butter takes users on a deeply calming and enriching exploration of their own consciousness.

Beyond its cerebral effects, Chem Butter exerts a powerful influence on both the mind and body, creating an unparalleled symphony of sensations. This strain strikes a perfect balance for cannabis enthusiasts, delivering a deeply sedative yet focused experience. Users can expect to be enveloped in a state of euphoria, accompanied by a surge of creative energy.

As the effects of Chem Butter intensify and gradually subside, a gentle wave of relaxation sweeps through the body, further enhancing feelings of peace and contentment. The all-encompassing after-effects contribute to a profound sense of satisfaction that permeates the user's being. Prepare yourself for an extraordinary and rejuvenating adventure that will captivate your senses and leave an indelible mark on your memory.

Enhanced by its terpene trio—Limonene, Pinene, and Terpinene—this vape cartridge offers layers of complexity. Terpinene contributes a floral and herbal nuance, ensuring a smooth and well-rounded flavor journey that delights with every draw.

Experience a surge of energized inspiration with Lemon Drop, perfect for moments when you seek a creative spark or a boost of positivity. Whether you're diving into an artistic project, enjoying a lively conversation, or embracing a day of exploration, Lemon Drop delivers a vibrant and uplifting high that keeps you inspired and engaged. 965.desc:

This strain is known for being used as remedies for many chronic health issues, such as lack of appetite, anxiety, nausea, fatigue, and depression. 

Similarly, the Clementine strain is excellent for boosting energy, gaining focus, and feeling euphoric. As a result, it’s one of the top cannabis strains for increasing your body’s energy levels.

The moment you take your first puff of Dawg Lemons, your creative juices start to flow and the ideas begin to come. Every sense seems heightened, as you are drawn into a blissful state of motivation. Whether you're trying to finish a project, have an engaging conversation, or simply let your creativity fly free, Dawg Lemons provides the spark that will bring your imagination to life. 969.desc:
Dr. Funkenstein, also known as "Dr. Funk," is an indica-dominant hybrid strain cultivated by Royal King Seeds. Born from the legendary union of Blueberry and Bubba Kush, this strain captures the best qualities of its renowned parentage. Dr. Funkenstein offers a flavorful journey that delights the palate with a blend of sweet berry notes and earthy sharpness, reflecting its rich genetic heritage.

The strain's primary terpene profile includes Myrcene, Pinene, and Caryophyllene, contributing to its distinctive flavors and effects. Myrcene enhances the sweet, fruity aroma and promotes a sense of relaxation. Pinene introduces subtle pine undertones that can uplift and refresh the senses, while Caryophyllene adds a spicy hint that elevates the overall taste experience. This harmonious combination results in a flavor profile featuring berry, blueberry, cheesy, and sweet notes that make each encounter with Dr. Funkenstein uniquely enjoyable.

Dr. Funkenstein is celebrated for inducing a multifaceted experience that pleasantly envelops both mind and body. Users often report an onset of euphoria and cerebral stimulation, fostering feelings of happiness and creativity. As the journey continues, it gradually transitions into a powerful body sensation that promotes deep relaxation and a laid-back state. This progression may lead to increased appetite and a gentle inclination toward introspection, accompanied by a soothing, sleepy feeling. Drawing from its Blueberry and Bubba Kush lineage, Dr. Funkenstein offers a well-rounded experience that balances uplifting mental effects with calming physical relaxation.

970.desc:
Ghost OG, a cut of OG Kush, is a hybrid strain loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects. Often described as simultaneously potent and non-intrusive, Ghost OG has won itself Cup awards and renown among consumers.

Despite its intimidating name, Ghost OG is actually a mellow, relaxing strain that’s great for recreational use. This is the strain to go to when you’re having a Netflix-and-Chill day at home. As an indica-dominant hybrid, Ghost OG can melt all your worries, stressors, and anxieties away and replace them with a soothing, peaceful experience. There’s nothing better than watching your favorite comedy or listening to your favorite album than with Ghost OG in the mix.

Even though the high of Ghost OG is noticeable, it’s rarely considered to be too overpowering or overwhelming. This hybrid comes with moderate THC levels that are suitable for all smoking levels. The overall experience of Ghost OG is zen, euphoric, and giggly. This hybrid produces a happy high that veers on the cerebral side in the early stages.

The second wave of Ghost OG shows its indica side. The brain and body enter a state of pure relaxation. This can help combat feelings of pain, anxiety, nausea, and inflammation. Any discomfort in the body with gradually fade away as you continue to smoke Ghost OG on the couch. It also might be a good idea to keep snacks around as this strain promotes the munchies.

971.desc:
GMO Cookies is a potent indica hybrid strain developed by Mamiko Seeds, born from the powerful cross of Girl Scout Cookies and Chemdog. Despite its name, GMO Cookies is not a genetically modified organism but a masterful blend of two legendary strains. This variety is celebrated for its unique flavor profile, featuring strong aromas of diesel, coffee, and fruit, with subtle hints of garlic, mushroom, and onion (GMO) inherited from its Chemdog lineage.

The strain's complex terpene profile includes Limonene, Caryophyllene, Myrcene, Humulene, and Bisabolol, contributing to its distinctive flavors and effects. Limonene adds a touch of citrus that uplifts the senses, while Caryophyllene introduces spicy notes that enhance the earthy and pungent aroma. Myrcene brings musky and herbal undertones, promoting a sense of relaxation. Humulene adds subtle earthy and woody flavors, and Bisabolol imparts gentle floral hints that round out the overall taste experience. This harmonious combination results in an earthy, pungent flavor with diesel overtones that linger on the palate.

GMO Cookies is renowned for its deeply relaxing effects that envelop the body while allowing the mind to remain focused. Users often report feeling relaxed, happy, and uplifted, enjoying a long-lasting high that soothes both mind and body. Drawing from its Girl Scout Cookies lineage, it offers euphoric and uplifting sensations that enhance mood and promote happiness. The Chemdog heritage contributes to the potent body relaxation, providing a soothing experience without total sedation. This balanced blend makes GMO Cookies a favorite among those seeking mental clarity paired with physical tranquility.

972.desc:
The GMO Cookies strain produces relaxing effects you can feel through your body while your mind retains focus. GMO Cookies is loved for its ability to relieve stress and aches without total sedation, while featuring strong aromas like diesel, coffee, and fruit. GMO Cookies is said to be the perfect choice for treating those suffering from conditions such as chronic pain insomnia, inflammation, chronic fatigue, depression, and chronic stress.

Contrary to what you might think, the GMO Cookies strain is not a genetically modified organism but a cross between Chemdawg D and a GSC (formerly Girl Scout Cookies) Forum cut. GMO Cookies is said to carry a flavor of garlic (G), mushroom (M), and onion (O) that

descends from its Chemdawg lineage. GMO Cookies is said to produce olive green buds with bits of purple and orange blanketed by a mantle of trichomes.

Known for its super pungent aroma and heavily sedative high, GMO Cookies is a favorite of indica lovers everywhere. This bud has a deliciously savory garlic flavor with a pungent spicy exhale that stays on your tongue long after your final toke. The GMO Cookies high is truly one to behold, with long-lasting effects that will have you flying high and staying there for hours on end before you fade away into a deep and peaceful sleep. You'll feel totally relaxed and lifted with a deep sense of relaxation that permeates both mind and body with heavily sedative effects.

973.desc:
Dungeon Vault Genetics’ Grapezilla stomps onto the scene as a mighty indica born from Original Glue and Vino OG. With Myrcene leading the charge, expect a mellow, musky earthiness that gently settles the mind, while Pinene’s crisp pine notes sharpen focus and clarity. Caryophyllene adds a peppery warmth that gives each inhale a spicy kick, and Limonene brings a bright citrus twist that lifts the senses. Humulene rounds out the profile with subtle herbal undertones.

Upon first puff, sweet grape flavors surge forward, underscored by a low rumble of diesel funk inherited from its Glue parentage. Myrcene’s cozy musk weaves through that grape sweetness, while Pinene’s refreshing forest breeze cuts through the richness. Caryophyllene’s peppery spice and Limonene’s lemon-lime flair mingle on the exhale, leaving a complex aftertaste that invites another toke.

Grapezilla’s effects mirror its terpene tapestry: a gradual wave of calm that encourages deep relaxation and puts the body at ease. Pinene’s clarity helps keep the mind gently engaged, so you can dive into a good book, sink into your favorite playlist, or simply relish a quiet moment. Caryophyllene’s warm embrace and Myrcene’s soothing weight make sinking into the couch all but inevitable, yet Limonene’s lift ensures you never lose complete alertness - truly the apex of chill.

976.desc:
Hibernate is a potent indica strain meticulously crafted by the master breeders at Greenpoint Seeds, born from the cross of Shut Eye and Stardawg. This unique blend brings together an impressive lineage that includes Fire OG, Bubba Kush, Alien Technology, Purple Kush, and Chemdog. Hibernate lives up to its name by offering deeply relaxing and soothing effects, making it an ideal choice for those seeking tranquility and restful sleep. Its terpene profile features Nerolidol 2, Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, and Bisabolol, all contributing to its distinctive flavor and calming properties.

The flavor profile of Hibernate leans toward earthy and woody notes, complemented by hints of pine and a strong lemon peel accent. Limonene adds a citrusy zest that brightens the overall taste, while Myrcene and Humulene contribute to the strain's herbal and earthy undertones. Bisabolol introduces subtle floral nuances, enhancing the complexity of the flavor. The aroma is equally captivating, with variations that include lemon tones, cherry, rock candy, and the skunky essence characteristic of Stardawg.

Drawing from its rich genetic background, Hibernate offers a profoundly relaxing and euphoric experience. Users often report feelings of deep calmness and serenity, with a gentle wave of sleepiness that envelops both mind and body. The influence of Shut Eye provides intensely soothing effects, while Stardawg adds a touch of uplifting euphoria. This harmonious blend makes Hibernate an excellent choice for unwinding after a long day, promoting a peaceful state of mind and preparing for a restful night's sleep.

Strain Type: Indica

Lineage: [Shuteye] x [Stardawg]

Lemon Tree Punch combines the sweet-and-sour tang of Lemon Tree and the fruity fragrance of Purple Punch. This variety smells strongly of lemon, grape, and berry, mixed with undertones of diesel fuel and wet soil. Lemon Tree Punch offers a rich flavor that is particularly complex. Depending on the phenotype, some plants may taste more of grape and berry, and others may be more citrusy. 

Lemon Tree Punch provides a balanced effect that is both stimulating and comforting. Users report that this strain boosts the mood and increases motivation when it is consumed in small doses. When consumed in greater quantities, this invigorating effect shifts into a mildly sedating stone that may reduce muscle tension and soothe the mind. Given its well-balanced effects, Lemon Tree Punch makes for a great all-day smoke.

982.desc:
Max AC stands as a pinnacle of hybrid ingenuity, brought to life by Greenpoint Genetics through an inspired cross of MAC 1 and Animal Cookies. This strain captures the essence of two powerhouse genetics, blending the resin-rich, robust character of MAC 1 with the flavor-forward, distinctive profile of Animal Cookies. The result is a hybrid that delivers a compelling fusion of clear-headed euphoria and soothing physical calm, tailored for those seeking both mental spark and grounded relaxation.

The flavor profile of Max AC is a journey in complexity and depth. It opens with a bright citrus burst provided by limonene, delivering an immediate zing that awakens the senses. The spicy, peppery nuances of caryophyllene interlace with the rich, earthy foundation of myrcene and humulene, creating a multi-layered taste that is both robust and satisfying. Bisabolol rounds out the experience with subtle floral hints, adding an elegant softness that completes the symphony of flavors. The result is an immersive, gourmet experience that dances between tangy citrus, spicy earthiness, and delicate floral sweetness.

As the high unfolds, Max AC sets the stage for a state of inspired focus and tranquil contentment. The initial rush sparks an elevated mood, fueling creative thoughts and a sense of invigorated drive—ideal for sketching out new ideas or engaging in reflective planning. Gradually, a soothing calm pervades the body, nurturing a feeling of quiet satisfaction and mental clarity. Max AC's dynamic progression from an energizing lift to a serene, grounding calm invites you to embrace an active, yet reflective state, transforming your day into an exploration of both creative vibrancy and peaceful repose.

986.desc:
Mintlato is a hybrid born of Animal Mints and Gelato 41, showcasing a terpene cast led by limonene, caryophyllene, humulene, myrcene, and pinene. At first draw, limonene brings a bright citrus zing that awakens the senses, while pinene’s fresh pine notes add a brisk clarity. Myrcene’s earthy, musky undertones lend a plush, soothing backdrop, and caryophyllene’s spicy warmth weaves through the mix, rounding out the flavor with a subtle peppery edge. Humulene’s herbal whisper ties everything together, creating a complex, mint-tinged profile that feels both crisp and luxuriant.

Onset is marked by a light uplift—limonene promotes a buoyant sense of optimism, lifting the spirit without racing the mind. As that initial glow settles, myrcene and humulene ease the body into gentle relaxation, melting away tension without heavy sedation. Pinene’s clarity helps maintain focus, keeping thoughts crisp even as a comfortable calm washes over you. The result is a balanced high that can fuel creative bursts, spark conversation, or simply enhance a lazy afternoon with a refreshing twist.

With its harmonious interplay of invigorating and soothing notes, Mintlato invites you to explore a variety of activities. Tackle a brainstorming session with newfound clarity, lose yourself in mellow music with a relaxed frame of mind, or savor a quiet moment of reflection as the minty breeze lingers on your palate - Mintlato adapts to your mood, amplifying joy and composure in equal measure.

Illicit l Soft Movie Popcorn Caramels 10pk l 100mg

Frozen plants are placed in a rosin press, which uses heat and pressure to extract a hot oil from the plants, which is rosin. The “live” in live rosin means frozen plants were used as the source material; when dried cannabis plant material is used, it is just rosin.

1264.desc:
Berry Kimber - Indica
Lineage: Billy Kimber x Sweet Retreat
-----
Berry Kimber is the velvet-gloved heavyweight of the cannabis world — a luscious Indica strain born from the legendary Billy Kimber and the decadent Sweet Retreat. This rare cross fuses mob-boss potency with dessert-like charm, delivering a knockout blend of power and pleasure.
-----
On the nose, Berry Kimber bursts with sweet forest berries, rich cream, and pine — like walking through a candy shop hidden deep in a redwood grove. The inhale is smooth and syrupy, with hints of blackberry jam and vanilla, while the exhale carries a calming earthiness that settles the senses.
-----
Expect a high that comes on like dusk: slow, warm, and all-consuming. Berry Kimber is perfect for deep relaxation, easing anxiety, muscle tension, and stubborn thoughts into sweet surrender. Ideal for evening use, this strain will have you melting into the couch while your mind floats through a haze of blissful calm.
-----
Whether you're winding down after a long day or just want to retreat into your own private sanctuary, Berry Kimber is your passport to indulgent tranquility — potent, peaceful, and irresistibly plush.

**A Legacy Rooted in the Heights, Cultivated in Jersey**

This drop is bigger than just flower. It’s about legacy, culture, and respect.

White Boy Kev is a Washington Heights legend. Back in the early 90’s, when the city was in the grip of the crack epidemic, Kev chose a different lane. He carved out his own path with weed because he never saw it as a drug – to him it was medicine, community, and love for the block. It was a way to uplift, not harm. Running three spots in the Heights, Kev built his name the real way: he gave the community something authentic, something that healed.

Fast-forward 35 years, and Kev's still in it for the plant – not just as a hustler, but as a grower. His pursuit now is mastery: learning, evolving, and working with cultivators who share his dedication to quality. That's why teaming up with niche. made sense – Jersey and Washington Heights are just a river apart, and this collaboration bridges that gap.

Irish Springz celebrates a genuine legend in the game. This is legacy work – paying homage to the ones who paved the way while pushing the culture forward.

Ultra-pure THCA crystals with a terpene-rich sauce are used to make Liquid Diamonds, a concentrate. THCA crystals, called "diamonds," come about through controlled crystallization.
